description: Dataset d'exigences automobiles (powertrain, safety, AUTOSAR, diagnostics, thermal, cybersecurity, vehicle control, integration). Fixture de demonstration.

exigences.text: The traction inverter shall limit motor phase current to 400 A.
The traction inverter shall limit motor phase current to 450 A.
The system shall detect DC bus overvoltage conditions within 10 ms.
The system shall detect DC bus undervoltage conditions within 10 ms.
The inverter shall disable torque production after detection of a critical fault.
The inverter shall continue torque production after detection of a critical fault.
The safety manager shall monitor execution of all ASIL-D software partitions.
The software shall perform RAM integrity tests at startup.
The software shall perform RAM integrity tests at start-up.
The CAN communication stack shall comply with AUTOSAR Classic Platform.
The diagnostic manager shall support UDS service 0x10.
The diagnostic manager shall support UDS service 0x11.
The ECU shall transmit heartbeat messages every 100 ms.
The ECU shall transmit heartbeat messages every 100 ms.
The ECU shall store a diagnostic trouble code when overtemperature is detected.
The ECU shall erase all diagnostic trouble codes at every ignition cycle.
The ECU shall retain diagnostic trouble codes across ignition cycles.
The inverter shall enter thermal derating mode above 110 degC.
The inverter shall enter thermal derating mode above 110°C.
The inverter cooling pump shall be activated when coolant temperature exceeds 70°C.
The ECU shall authenticate all software updates before installation.
The ECU shall allow software updates without authentication.
The bootloader shall verify the digital signature of firmware images.
The torque request shall be limited to 100 percent.
The torque request shall not exceed 100%.
The accelerator pedal position shall be sampled every 5 ms.
The accelerator pedal position shall be sampled every 50 ms.
The motor speed shall be measured using a resolver sensor.
The motor speed shall be measured using a resolver sensor
The safety watchdog shall reset the ECU if the main control task fails to execute within 100 ms.
The safety watchdog shall never reset the ECU.
All software components shall log errors in a centralized event memory.
All software components shall logs errors in a centralized event memory.
The system shall support CAN FD communication at 2 Mbps.
The system shall support CAN FD communication at 500 kbps.
